products.name: Hidden Legends Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs, no code card. Groudon, the secret rare box topper, is not in the packs. TCGplayer has no market price for the box, only a single $52,400 listing (its mid price), which is used as it is: thin (36 packs at the $800 pack would be $28,800).

products.name: EX Value Pack II [Typhlosion]
products.note: Three EX packs, one each from Team Magma vs Team Aqua, Hidden Legends and Team Rocket Returns, and the cosmos holo Typhlosion NP 34 (Sep 2006; pkmn.gg's NP34 variant text 'Value Pack II', TCGplayer's listing 90104 'Typhlosion - 034 (Epic Collection Value Boxes)'; the pack mix is Bulbapedia via a search excerpt only: low-medium, and the one-of-each split is the reading of 'Magma/Aqua, Hidden Legends, Team Rocket Returns mix'). TCGplayer has no listing for the box: priced from its three packs at the Hidden Legends pack price plus the promo.
